# motherduck_service_account (Resource)

Creates a MotherDuck service account through the public REST API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "motherduck_service_account" "app" {
  username = "analytics_app"
}

resource "motherduck_access_token" "app" {
  username   = motherduck_service_account.app.username
  name       = "terraform-managed"
  token_type = "read_write"
  ttl        = 2592000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String) Unique service account username. Must start with an ASCII letter, contain only ASCII letters, digits, and underscores, and be at most 255 characters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Service account ID. This is the service account username returned by MotherDuck.
